resources.contents:
openapi: "3.0.0"

info:
  title: Edubit API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: OpenAPI spec for Edubit's workshop schedulers
  contact:
    name: HMCA

tags:
  - name: Schedulers
    description: All operations related workshop schedulers


components:
  schemas:
    ServiceResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        $metadata:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/metadata'
        ScheduleArn:
          type: string
          format: ARN
      required:
        - $metadata
        - ScheduleArn
    metadata:
      type: object
      properties:
        httpStatusCode:
          type: integer
        requestId:
          type: string
          format: UUID
        attempts:
          type: integer
        totalRetryDelay:
          type: integer
      required:
        - httpStatusCode
        - requestId
        - attempts
        - totalRetryDelay

servers:
  - url: https://{gateway}.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/{stage}/schedulers
    description: URL on AWS cloud
    variables:
      gateway:
        enum: [bzyw0cecwc]
        default: bzyw0cecwc
      stage:
        enum: [dev, qa, live]
        default: dev

paths:
  /{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get scheduler
      description: Get scheduler information
      operationId: getScheduler
      tags:
        - Schedulers
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: UUID
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Scheduler successfully retrieved
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ServiceResponse'
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
  /{id}/start:
    post:
      summary: Start scheduler
      description: Initiates a startup timer related to a scheduled workshop
      operationId: startScheduler
      tags:
        - Schedulers
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: UUID
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Scheduler successfully initiated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ServiceResponse'
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
  /{id}/pause:
    patch:
      summary: Pause scheduler
      description: Stops temporarily the countup timer associated to a scheduled workshop. Send /resume to continue counting.
      operationId: pauseScheduler
      tags:
        - Schedulers
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: UUID
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Scheduler successfully paused
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ServiceResponse'
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
  /{id}/resume:
    patch:
      summary: Resume scheduler
      description: Restarts the countup timer associated to a scheduled workshop.
      operationId: resumeScheduler
      tags:
        - Schedulers
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: UUID
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Scheduler successfully resumed
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ServiceResponse'
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
  /{id}/stop:
    delete:
      summary: Stop scheduler
      description: Removes the countup timer associated to a scheduled workshop.
      operationId: stopScheduler
      tags:
        - Schedulers
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: UUID
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Scheduler successfully removed
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
